skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understanding the role of accounting in organizations
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will be able to identify the nature, position, and role of accounting in an organization.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Recognizing and applying generally accepted accounting principles (GAAP)
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will understand GAAP principles for recognizing, measuring, and recording accounting objects and providing financial information.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Applying accounting principles to prepare financial statements
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will apply accounting principles to present items on basic financial statements.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Analyzing and evaluating financial performance and business results
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will use accounting principles to analyze and evaluate the financial situation and business results of an entity.
Students will develop skills in systematic thinking, analyzing transactions, identifying, classifying, measuring, and recording accounting activities in organizations.
Students will demonstrate basic communication skills, write professional reports, and give presentations in their work.
Students will use skills for independent and effective teamwork.
Students will adapt to working environments in regional and international contexts.
Students will recognize social responsibilities in the accounting profession.
Students will discuss basic accounting issues.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Expressing opinions on basic accounting issues
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will express opinions on basic accounting issues.
